artifact_type: input-identity versus state-specific representative-vocabulary recurrence diagnostic
description: For each recorded state and cosine sector, compare the union of representative token IDs in each of 32 next-token decision networks over all 496 unordered decision pairs. Partition by whether the *input token ID* at the decision position is identical or different. Repetition, shared context and stochastic independence are not assumed.
limits: Only 12 representative token IDs per community, not all selected vocabulary memberships
One repeated continuation, not independent prompts
Shared late-state vocabulary may reflect projection/model-wide biases rather than task-specific knowledge
No semantic truth or causal inference from these Jaccard values
